note: Lab ladders from game data v29.2.1 (build 1294), with no cost or time modifier applied: Labs Coin Discount at 0, Labs Speed at its level-0 x1 and no relic, for those two labs' own ladders too. labs[] is every LAB_CATALOG lab whose cost and time the game's lab table gives, by research index. labs[].levels[i] is level i+1: cost is coins as the game computes it (single precision, so 2.05e15 reads 2049999952316284.2), seconds is research time to the whole second, benefit is the lab's total value once that level is done, as the game stores it and in the lab's own unit (Double Death Ray stores 0.01 for 1%, Labs Coin Discount 0.3 for 0.3%, Super Tower Bonus 1.03 for x1.03). Not here: the card masteries and the effect-ban labs (194-197), for which the table gives no cost or time, and the battle-condition labs (206-219), for which it gives no time; their costs match LAB_CATALOG. The game has no Ray, Scatter or Vampire Enemy Defense lab.
